name: update-progress-uptodate
description: S→C update.progress push (protocol 1.8, SPEC §7, D-10): the terminal success-with-nothing-to-do shape — stage `uptodate` and NOTHING else. No `pct` (not `downloading`), no `error` (not `failed`), and no `version` is required to say "you already have it". Proves all three optional keys stay ABSENT on canonical re-encode rather than being emitted as null.
